Without edge 5, edge 3 is one of the few routes to the output, so deleting it is far more damaging (exps 32/34 vs 31/33).
Restoring a missing direct input-output path adds a residual connection rather than replacing a useful op (exps 3/4 vs 1/2).
When the direct input-output edge is missing, a skip on edge 5 supplies the residual-like path the cell lacks (exps 83/87/90).
Replacing parameter-free pooling at the head of the cell with a conv adds more capacity than replacing skip or 1x1 conv (exps 92/100).
If edge 5 is none, node 2 never reaches the output, so a conv on edge 1 adds cost without contributing (pairs 51/52, 53/54, 55/56).
With edge 0 removed, node 1 receives no input, so strengthening edge 4 adds little (pairs 65/66, 69/70).
Swapping a 3x3 conv on the final edge for pooling loses more capacity than swapping out a skip (exp 49 vs 50).
Adding pooling where there was no edge adds a path, while replacing a conv removes capacity (exp 44 vs 41).
Deleting a parameter-free skip on edge 0 costs less than deleting a learned conv, which feeds all of node 1's downstream paths (exps 25/26/30 vs 27/28).

Hypotheses drawn from the strongest contrasts in the 100 experiments, plus how cells in this space are wired:

- **Edge 3 removal (exps 31–38):** Removing edge 3 is catastrophic, around −75 on C10, when edges 4 and 5 are both none. Then node 3 has no other input.
- **Restoring edge 3 (exps 3, 4 vs 1, 2, 5–9):** Adding skip_connect to edge 3 helps much more when edge 3 was none. It restores the direct input-to-output path.
- **Edge 5 to skip (exps 83, 87, 90 vs others):** This edit is strongly positive only when edge 3 is none, because it supplies a residual-like path to the output.
- **Edge 1 to conv3x3 (pairs 51/52, 53/54, 55/56):** The edit consistently does worse when edge 5 is none. Node 2's output then reaches the output only through node 2, which feeds nothing.
- **Edge 4 to conv3x3 (pairs 65/66, 69/70):** The edit does worse when edge 0 is none. Node 1 then has no input, so edge 4 carries nothing useful.
- **Edge 0 to conv3x3 (exps 92, 100):** Gains are largest when the replaced op is avg_pool_3x3.
